paragraphs.text: Lessons for children aged 5 to 11 run on Saturday mornings for ten weeks, starting on 13 September. Each group has no more than eight children and one qualified instructor. Parents must stay in the building during lessons but may not watch from the poolside; a viewing area is available upstairs. The fee of £75 for the term includes a free swimming cap.

items.quote: Parents must stay in the building during lessons but may not watch from the poolside; a viewing area is available upstairs

options.text: wait in the viewing area upstairs.

explanation.en: “may not watch from the poolside; a viewing area is available upstairs” → B. A is not allowed, and C contradicts “must stay in the building”.
explanation.kk: «may not watch from the poolside; a viewing area is available upstairs» → B. A-ға тыйым салынған, C «must stay in the building» дегенге қайшы.
explanation.ru: «may not watch from the poolside; a viewing area is available upstairs» → B. A запрещено, C противоречит «must stay in the building».

groups.instruction: Question 1. Look at the text. Choose the correct letter, A, B, C or D.

items.quote: Each group has no more than eight children and one qualified instructor
items.prompt: Which TWO of the following are stated in the text?

options.text: A swimming cap is included in the fee.
Groups have a maximum of eight children.
Transport to the pool is provided.
Lessons also run on weekday evenings.

explanation.en: “no more than eight children” (B) and “The fee … includes a free swimming cap” (A). Transport (C) and a certificate (D) are not mentioned, and lessons are only on Saturdays (E).
explanation.kk: «no more than eight children» (B) және «The fee … includes a free swimming cap» (A). Көлік (C) пен сертификат (D) аталмайды, сабақ тек сенбіде (E).
explanation.ru: «no more than eight children» (B) и «The fee … includes a free swimming cap» (A). Транспорт (C) и сертификат (D) не упомянуты, занятия только по субботам (E).

groups.instruction: Questions 2–3. Look at the text. Choose TWO letters, A–E.

steps.en: The question is about parents during lessons. Scan for “parents”.
steps.kk: Сұрақ сабақ кезіндегі ата-аналар туралы. Мәтіннен «parents» сөзін іздейміз.
steps.ru: Вопрос о родителях во время занятий. Ищем «parents» в тексте.

steps.en: “Parents must stay in the building during lessons but may not watch from the poolside; a viewing area is available upstairs”.
steps.kk: «Parents must stay in the building during lessons but may not watch from the poolside; a viewing area is available upstairs».
steps.ru: «Parents must stay in the building during lessons but may not watch from the poolside; a viewing area is available upstairs».

steps.en: In our own words: stay in the building, not at the poolside but upstairs. That is B.
steps.kk: Өз сөзімізбен: ғимаратта қалу керек, бірақ бассейн шетінде емес, жоғарғы қабатта. Бұл — B.
steps.ru: Своими словами: остаться в здании, но не у бассейна, а наверху. Это B.

steps.en: A uses “poolside” from the text, but there it is forbidden; C contradicts “must stay”. Answer: B.
steps.kk: A мәтіндегі «poolside» сөзін алады, бірақ онда бұл тыйым; C «must stay» дегенге қайшы. Жауап — B.
steps.ru: A берёт слово «poolside» из текста, но там оно в запрете; C противоречит «must stay». Ответ B.

steps.en: “Choose TWO letters”: we need two letters, each confirmed by the text.
steps.kk: «Choose TWO letters»: екі әріп керек, әрқайсысы мәтінмен расталуы тиіс.
steps.ru: «Choose TWO letters»: нужно две буквы, и каждая должна подтверждаться текстом.

steps.en: Check each option: groups of up to eight — “no more than eight children” (B); the cap — “includes a free swimming cap” (A).
steps.kk: Нұсқаларды кезекпен тексереміз: топта сегізге дейін бала — «no more than eight children» (B); бас киім — «includes a free swimming cap» (A).
steps.ru: Проверяем варианты по очереди: группа до восьми детей — «no more than eight children» (B); шапочка — «includes a free swimming cap» (A).

steps.en: C and D are not in the text, and E contradicts “Saturday mornings”. Choose A and B — exactly two letters.
steps.kk: C мен D мәтінде жоқ, E «Saturday mornings» дегенге қайшы. A мен B-ны таңдаймыз — дәл екі әріп.
steps.ru: C и D в тексте нет, E противоречит «Saturday mornings». Выбираем A и B — ровно две буквы.
